title: ModelDiff
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool model diff <baseFile> <headFile>` (MODEL-REVIEW-SPEC §5) — a STRUCTURAL diff of two models: it parses both into the model and compares structure, so a pure reformat is never reported. `changes` lists every field and rule that was added, removed, or modified between base and head, each with the per-aspect `deltas` that changed (a rule's condition/severity/code; a field's kind and per-kind config). For an ADDED element a delta carries only `after`; for REMOVED, only `before`; for MODIFIED, both. Element ids are field paths or rule full names.

changes.description: the element-level changes (fields and rules added/removed/modified) — base order, then head-only additions

element.description: the element family that changed (computation/group are a later slice)

id.description: the element's path (field) or full name (rule)

change.description: how the element changed between base and head

deltas.description: the aspects that differ — every aspect for ADDED/REMOVED, only the differing ones for MODIFIED

before.description: the base-side value (absent when the element is ADDED)

after.description: the head-side value (absent when the element is REMOVED)
